catalog.title: Credor V1
catalog.note: JDM Credor catalogue from 1978, the earlier of the two 1978 editions, still printed under the line's first name CRÊT D'OR (クレドール, 《セイコークオーツ クレドール》), published by K. Hattori & Co. Men's gold dress quartz on scan pages 3-18 (p8 = the 1.9 mm ultra-thin 5931 models), ladies' models on p20-29, ending with the 18K quartz pocket watch HNA-640; p2, p9, p19 and p24 are uncaptioned mood photos, p1 a text page and p0/p30 the covers, none of them records. Every watch sits in its own dark studio panel with the caption printed below: model number ("HHG 021" -> ref HHG-021), price in yen, case material (18KWG -> 18K WG, 18K) with crystal and stone-dial notes, then the movement and a case-dial number, e.g. 7820<508-510> -> caliber 7820, caseDialCode 508-510 (58KQW on HHB-010/804 is a family code, not a caliber, so it stays only in `code`), and for strap models the strap code (LK 467 ...) kept in `bracelet`. No jewel counts, case refs or water resistance are printed. Credor V2 (1978-1978-credor-v2) re-uses many of these photos and captions on re-laid-out pages, some re-priced; three V2 pages repeat V1 pages outright (V2 p7 = top row of V1 p7, V2 p9 = V1 p10, V2 p12 = V1 p12) and are digitised once, here, where the pages are complete. Every record that also appears in V2 says so in `notes`, with V2's scan page and price.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders of all 31 scan pages (Oct 2026), one record per pictured watch in caption order, verified against full-resolution caption crops and cross-checked with the PDF text layer (the scan wins where they differ).
